decisions.reason: Certified plate heat exchangers for HVAC fit the firm's core heat-transfer competence, and with only a brief website mention there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspiration, so routine continuation is likely.
The firm reports a major market share in water cooling systems, so the box cooler appears to exceed aspirations and calls for no problemistic search.
The marine cooling unit has its own page and complements the successful box cooler line, so management will likely keep it while its results develop.
The compact oil cooler gets only a minimal mention and its results are uncertain, but it is a low-cost extension of the existing range that slack can carry for another year.
Finned tubes for air coolers have a dedicated page and are a core component technology, so there is no trigger for dropping them.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are prominently presented and draw on the firm's core tube competence, so they are likely to be retained.
